ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with less than 5% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized to the distal tips and specific surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity field across 95% of the visible fluke; small high-intensity contiguous blobs at the far-left and far-right distal margins; sparse high-intensity circular clusters on the upper-left lateral quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression approximately 110-130 degrees; base of notch partially obscured by water turbulence pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; distinct jagged peaks and deep valleys across the entire linear span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity transitioning into sharp angularity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (approximately 4-6 on left tip, 3-5 on right tip) corresponding to focal point scarring or barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, darker than the surrounding black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Macroscopic jagged notches and irregular missing sections along the trailing edge topography; white scarring clusters at the distal tips.
